rows: - Found and fixed in the suite, not the code: `wf browser navigate` on a launched session returned before the app frame had loaded (a test serving the page's script 400 ms late fails on the old binary, and so did the coverage test, which had only failed by chance), the auth-listener suite removed its browser profile while the browser still wrote it (ENOTEMPTY, about one run in three), and a long file of blocking `spawnSync` tests outlasted vitest's 60 s reply wait (a yield after each test). Final state: 86 files, 1,132 passed, 3 skipped, two consecutive full runs green. One failure of `tailscale-rotate.integration.test.ts` (5 tests, exit 1 with an empty stdout) was seen once in about ten full runs and did not reproduce; its assertions now carry the command's stderr so the next occurrence explains itself.
